hero_code:
let view ~name ~cta () =
"JSX for OCaml"

("Hello, " ^ name ^ ".")

"Write UI in OCaml with JSX syntax."
syntax_before:
([@JSX]
  section(
    ~className="hero",
    ~children=[
      ([@JSX] h1(~children=["Hello"], ())),
      ([@JSX] p(~children=["OCaml, now with JSX syntax."], ())),
    ],
    (),
  ))
